messages.subject: Lunchtime CPD: Disclosure under PD 57AD - 4 June, 1pm
messages.plaintextBody:
A reminder that our next lunchtime CPD session, 'Extended Disclosure under PD 57AD - practical tips and common pitfalls', takes place on Wednesday 4 June at 1pm in the Bishopsgate Room (and on Teams). Sandwiches provided. 1 CPD hour. Please register via the L&D portal.

Knowledge & Learning Team
